collateral_ratio_scale_basis: every collateral_ratio in this file is a multiple; 1.5135 means 151.35%. Matches the scale published on the snapshot — do not infer it from the field name.
history_coverage: Collateral history starts 2026-09-22, the day the writer was added — NOT the day DUSD started. No backfill. The peg series (dusd_alto_peg_history.json) is separate and forward-only from 2026-09-21; an independent 283-sample archive reconstruction exists as data/dusd_alto_peg_backfill.json and is held standalone by operator decision.
collateral_ratio_basis: collateral_ratio here is the USM tranche ratio (frxUSD held / DUSD minted, ~1:1 to the wei), NOT a whole-asset ratio. DUSD deliberately publishes no single collateral_ratio: the USM tranche has zero buffer while CDP collateral is isolated and not a general DUSD-holder claim, so blending them hides opposite failure modes. cdp_ratio and arithmetic_only_blended_ratio are recorded beside it; the blend is informational arithmetic and never a safety margin.
